content: Degisoggu, a-ular an be-ogannomar, an bemarga sogmarsun:

content.text: degi, bela dog-nuedye be Bab-Dummadga sogmar.

content: Ar wede, deyob-Babse-goled, igar-nuedid, degi, Bab-Dummad-anmar-Abonoged yeer we-igar itomogad.
Ar ade, Bab-Dummad binsamaid, bela-dulemar bitigi abonolesana gadinye, degine, bela igar-napiragwad wisgumalana yeerbanye.
Ar Bab-Dummad unnila wargwenna gued. Degine, dulemar-anar Bab-Dummad-irwa-gwisguedi unnila wargwenna gubalid. A-dulede, dule-sunnadid, Cristo-Jesúsʼye-nugad.
A-Jesucristoʼde bela dulemar-abonogega, burgwega na san-uksa gusad. We-ibmar, Bab-Dummadi, e-wilubgan-mosgu, deyob-guega imaksad, adi, oyogega, Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-abonomaiye.

A-ular, a-igargi-sunmakega an barmialealid, degi, Jesucristo-e-sapin-bur-dummadga-gumogaga an nug-imaklesad. Napira an bemarga soged, an gakansasulid. Jesúsʼgi-bensulidgi, degi, napiragwadgi Judíoʼsurmalad-odurdakega an nug-imaklesad.
Degisoggu, a-ular, an abedo, machergan bela-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladi, urwedginsuli, degi, na abin-abin imakedginsurbali, unnila gwage-swilidikidgi, Babse goled.

Aginbali, an abebardo, omeganmo, nue-wilubbali, dogdar wilub-obichasuli, nuedgi, mor yomarmogad. Omegan, mer dogdar wilub-obicha sailagia nudakmalo, degi, olomar, winimar, molamar-gargemalad dogdar-obichaa mer yomarbalo.
Ar unnila ibmar-nuegan-imakedbarbi omegan san ogannomalad. Mor-yeerdakle-yoedgi na san ogannosurmalad. Ar igi omegan-nue-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad damala, deyob bemar daewilubmarmogad.
Ome nue-bogidikidgi, ibmar-itosiidgi, degi, urbaligwa-daedgi, ibmar-durdakewilubbid.
Ar ome machered-odurdaked an abesurbalid, degine, mer machered-birgi obichaa dabalo. Unnila bogidik nue-itosii guoed.
Ar ade, Bab-Dummad Adán-inse ogwichisad, geb a-sorba, Eva-ogwisnonikid.
Deginbali, Adán gwen nia-sailase binsaed-galessulid, Eva nia-sailase yardaklesgusad. Degisoggu, Eva isgunonisunnad. A-ulale, omegan machergan-birgi daewilubsulid.
Degi-inigwele, ome dula-urbedgi, bendaklegoed. Bab-Jesúsʼgi-bensulile, sabguele, gwage-swilidikile, degi, dogdar-obichadasulile, bendaklegoed.
